EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows strong aliphatic C–H stretches at 2933 and 2887 cm⁻¹ (GFQ-003) and a distinct band at 1660 cm⁻¹ consistent with an N=O stretch of an alkyl nitrite rather than a carbonyl (no ester/ketone C=O near 1715–1750 cm⁻¹, excluding 3, 6, 8, 10). The pair at 817/801 cm⁻¹ matches nitrite/ONO bending near ~806 cm⁻¹ (GFQ-022), and the 889 cm⁻¹ band is in the expected N–O stretch region for R–ONO. Additional peaks at 1039, 1057, and 1108 cm⁻¹ fit C–O stretching modes of R–O–N=O. Absence of OH (~3200–3600) and Si–H (~2100–2200) bands excludes 9 and 7; lack of N–H stretch excludes the amide (4). Between nitrite candidates, the missing ~1375 cm⁻¹ CH₃ symmetric deformation favors the n-butyl nitrite (1) over the more CH₃-rich isopropyl nitrite (2).
